original.subject: [URGENT] Remote SIS Logic Validation — TVC-JMP-02 Session
original.body:
Victor,

We have accessed the TVC-JMP-02 terminal via the approved vendor VPN and confirmed the following:

- A command to close ESD-310 was issued from TVC-JMP-02 at 08:58:12.
- The SIS logic on TS-EWS-01 has not been updated from the archived v2.1.6 (approved file FPD-6.3-F-4).
- The running version (v2.1.7) was not approved in any MOC.

This is a confirmed cyber intrusion. Do not reset. Begin isolation per TVCC-CFW-OTSEC-2026, Play 4.

For immediate assistance, contact Schneider Electric Emergency Response at +1-800-555-0276 (24/7). Do not proceed without verification from your OT team.

Regards,

Ridgeline Automation Support
Schneider Electric Partner
1-800-555-0276
www.ridgelineautomation.com
